name: AI-Powered Website Builder with Gemini 3
headline: AI-Powered Website Builder with Gemini 3: Create
short_description: This skill enables users to design visually appealing, high-quality websites using AI tools like Gemini 3 within minutes. Users can use vibrant design elements and prompt techniques to customize websites based on specific branding and design preferences.
author: shyft-ai

sections.overview:
The AI-Powered Website Builder with Gemini 3 is an innovative Claude Code skill designed to simplify the website creation process. By leveraging advanced AI tools, users can quickly design visually appealing and high-quality websites tailored to their specific branding and design preferences. This skill enables the customization of vibrant design elements and prompt techniques, allowing users to create professional-looking sites in a fraction of the time it would typically take. One of the key benefits of this skill is the significant time savings it offers. While the exact time savings are currently unknown, users can typically expect to implement this skill within just one hour. This efficiency is particularly valuable for developers, product managers, and AI practitioners who need to deliver projects quickly without compromising on quality. The intermediate difficulty level ensures that users with some technical background can easily navigate the tool and make the most of its capabilities. This skill is ideal for a variety of use cases, including creating professional landing pages for businesses and clients, designing customized digital portfolios for personal branding, and developing agency websites that feature modern design and effective UX/UI elements. By streamlining the website building process, this skill fits seamlessly into AI-first workflows, allowing teams to focus on strategy and creativity rather than getting bogged down in technical details. Overall, the AI-Powered Website Builder with Gemini 3 is a powerful addition to any developer’s toolkit. Its ability to facilitate rapid website creation aligns perfectly with the growing demand for efficient AI automation solutions. As businesses increasingly seek to enhance their online presence, this skill offers a practical and effective way to meet those needs while saving valuable time.
Creating professional landing pages for businesses and clients
Designing customized digital portfolios or personal branding websites
Developing agency websites with modern flair and effective UX/UI elements
sections.setup: No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
sections.usage:
```
1. Upload a screenshot of the desired reference design or a clear idea of your brand aesthetic.
2. Use the prompt below:

'Create a landing page for my [BUSINESS_TYPE] called [BUSINESS_NAME]. The design should be inspired by [REFERENCE_WEBSITE] with a [COLOR_SCHEME]-colored theme. Consider using [DESIGN_ELEMENTS] and implement a modern, sleek layout in line with the style of [REFERENCE_IMAGE]. Emphasize [KEY_FEATURES] and include sections such as [SECTION_NAMES] with potential animations.'
```
Copy

```
A sleek, modern landing page featuring a hero section with a call-to-action, a feature overview, client testimonials, and an animated footer that matches the client's color scheme and branding.
```
